Class JsonSchemaNaming

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.jsonschema.naming.JsonSchemaNaming
@Internal public final class JsonSchemaNaming extends Object
The naming of the JSON schemas generated for JsonSchema types.

The annotation processor names the generated META-INF/<outputLocation>/<name>.schema.json files and their $id with these methods, and the runtime uses the same methods to find the schema of a type.

Since:
2.3.2
